verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own platform takes some automatic actions on events. Its agentic workflows auto-escalate high-risk cases and auto-remediate level 1 alerts, and users can set the risk-score equation, screening configurations and per-customer monitoring configurations that govern how alerts are raised. WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks let downstream systems react to screening events. However, no evidence shows a general user-authored rules engine (if-event-then-action), and agent configurations cannot be customized on the Starter plan. Missing for 10: documented user-defined event→action rule authoring, configurable automated actions beyond alert/case handling, transaction-monitoring rule customization details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
